question: The value of cot 15° cot 25° cot 45° cot 75° cot 65° is:
solution:
**Given: **

cot 15°cot 25°cot 45° cot 75°cot 65°

**Formulas used: **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7347c65130878338cbc774f54a0e6acb197b286c0737a31e05f4e7a5af690dc.png] 

**Calculation: **

cot 15°cot 25°cot 45° cot 75°cot 65°

⇒ cot 15° × cot 25° × cot 45° × cot (90° - 15°) × cot (90° - 25°)

⇒ cot 15° × cot 25° × cot 45° × tan15° × tan 25°

⇒ 1 × 1× 1 = 1
